title: Applications I: centre-symmetry transfer of the parity theorem, the link-flip lemma and the first-order Wilson mean across gauge groups, with the SU(3) and SO(3) obstructions and the SU(2) area-parity corollary
selected_after_note: drafted and frozen during BC production because no BD1 item depends on a BC outcome; its gate is recorded after the BC gates
selection_reason: The Round32 centre-grading parity theorem and link-flip lemma (AW1) were proved for SU(2) from two structural facts: a central element acting as -1 on the Wilson representation and a vanishing third Haar moment. The applications stage asks where these equations transfer. BD1 turns the two facts into criteria, tests them exactly on a frozen list of gauge groups with two independent routes, records the SU(3) and SO(3) obstructions with exact nonzero coefficients, and applies the flip lemma with the BB2 whole-sequence convergence to make the SU(2) area parity pointwise for the limit of the named constructions.
model: FG one-plaquette models H_FG(G) = 32 C_2 - (tau/3) W on class functions of the plaquette holonomy for G in {SU(2), SU(3), SU(4), SU(5), U(1), Z2, SO(3)} (fundamental or vector Wilson representation; frozen convention in parameters.convention); Haar moments of W for these groups; the flip sets E_3 on centered boxes of Z^3 (and the 24-link coarse factors) and E_2 on centered boxes of Z^2; the SU(2) zero-selected patterned family (AM2/AQ1, |tau|<=10^-8) for the area-parity corollary, in every open centered whole-star box and for the limit of the named constructions admitted in BB2.

parameters.metric: not applicable to the group cells (exact moments and exact finite-model coefficients); trace norm on B(H_Y) and the coarse l-infinity metric for the SU(2) corollary through BB2
parameters.window: not applicable (static and first/second-order coefficients only)
parameters.clock: not applicable to the group cells; the SU(2) corollary uses the admitted clocks unchanged
parameters.convention: per-link electric term 8 C_2(r) with C_2 the quadratic Casimir normalized so that C_F = (N^2-1)/(2N) for SU(N), C_2 = n^2 for U(1) charge n, and for Z2 the electric term with eigenvalue 0 on the even and 1 on the odd link state; SO(3) with C_2(l) = l(l+1), so the vector representation has C_F = 2 (the SU(2) adjoint value under the SU(N) rule); magnetic term -(tau/3) sum_f W_f with W_f = Re chi_fund(U_f)/dim fund (W = cos theta for U(1), W = sigma^z product for Z2, W = Tr/3 for SO(3)); face energy 32 C_F; first-order creation c^(1) = -(tau/3)/(32 C_F) sum_f W_f Omega_0 and omega(W) = 2 (tau/3) E[W^2]/(32 C_F) + O(tau^2) under the I1.5 sign

hamiltonian_terms.term: electric: 32 C_2(r) on the character chi_r of the plaquette holonomy (four links, each 8 C_2)
magnetic: W = Re chi_fund(U)/dim fund of the plaquette holonomy

parameters.flip_sets: E_3 = {(p,x): p_y even} u {(p,y): p_z even} u {(p,z): p_x even} (AW1) on Lambda_N of Z^3, N=2,3,4, and on the 24-link coarse factors; E_2 = {(p,x): p_y even} on [-N,N]^2, N=2,3,4
parameters.area_parity: for SU(2), kappa=0, every loop C of plaquette edges bounding a surface of A(C) plaquettes in the box: omega_{N,-tau}(W_C) = (-1)^{A(C)} omega_{N,tau}(W_C) in every open centered whole-star box and on-site cutoff, and omega^{-tau}_inf(W_C) = (-1)^{A(C)} omega^{tau}_inf(W_C) for the limit of the named constructions (BB2 whole-sequence convergence at each sign)

required: 1. Criterion A (flip): prove that if a central z of G acts as -I in the Wilson representation, the operator U_E (z on every link of a flip set E meeting every plaquette an odd number of times) commutes with every link Casimir and gauge action, fixes the vacuum and maps every W_f to -W_f, so U_E H(tau) U_E^* = H(-tau); state for each listed group whether such z exists, with the exact reason.

2. Criterion B (parity): prove that the first-order tau-derivatives of omega(W^2) and of the centred Euclidean and real-time correlations vanish when E_Haar[W^3]=0 and single-occurrence orthogonality hold (the AW1 argument with the group's moments), and that they are nonzero in the one-plaquette model when E_Haar[W^3] is nonzero.

3. Moment table: compute exactly E_Haar[W^k], k=1..4, for every listed group by the packet's route (forward: characters, Peter-Weyl and tensor-product multiplicities; reverse: Weyl integration over the maximal torus by constant-term extraction, with U(1) and Z2 by direct integration or summation), and the first-order coefficient 2 (1/3) E[W^2]/(32 C_F) of omega(W)/tau under the frozen convention.

4. Obstruction cells (mandatory): for SU(3) and SO(3), prove there is no central element acting as -1, compute E[W^3] exactly, and on the one-plaquette model H_FG(G) compute exactly by Rayleigh-Schroedinger the first-order tau-derivative of omega(W^2) and the second-order coefficient of omega(W), both nonzero; record that omega(W) is not odd in tau for these groups.

5. Flip sets: verify E_3 and E_2 by exact enumeration on the named boxes (every plaquette met an odd number of times; E_2 exactly once) and E_3 on the 24-link coarse factors; record periodic tori with an odd side as an obstruction.

6. SU(2) area parity: prove the area-parity corollary in every open centered whole-star box at kappa=0 from the AW1 flip lemma (|C intersect E| has the parity of A(C)), and for the limit of the named constructions pointwise from BB2 whole-sequence convergence at each sign; state that centre-even observables (Casimirs, W^2) are even in tau.

7. Write the transfer ledger: one row per group and equation (flip lemma, parity theorem, first-order coefficient, dictionary) with transfer or obstruction and its exact reason; the AM2/AQ chain for groups other than SU(2) as obligations.
8. Quote the mandatory sentence template once as one unbroken span; export the gate fields; every control executed as a damaging mutation; exact checker byte-identical under -B and -B -O.
claim_exclusions: any AM2, AV1 or AQ statement for a group other than SU(2)
a dictionary to a bare coupling for a group other than SU(2)
any estimate uniform in the lattice spacing a
direction_note: Forward: characters, Peter-Weyl orthogonality and tensor-product multiplicities. Reverse: Weyl integration over the maximal torus by constant-term extraction (direct integration or summation for U(1) and Z2). Both use the admitted AW1 argument for the SU(2) structure; independence is limited to route and code.

acceptance.accepted_within_scope: Both routes agree exactly on every moment and coefficient of every listed group; criteria A and B are proved; both obstruction cells are exhibited with exact nonzero coefficients; the flip sets are verified; the SU(2) area parity is proved in every box and pointwise for the limit of the named constructions; the transfer ledger is complete.
acceptance.limited: A group cell is missing or misclassified by a criterion, or the routes disagree on a cell, or the area parity for the limit is not proved (box level only); each recorded.
acceptance.insufficient: Criterion A or B is not proved, or an obstruction cell is not exhibited; the SU(2) record then stands only as admitted.

control_semantics_note: Inherited control ids are defined in the frozen contracts research/round33/contracts/ba1.json and bb2.json (declared premises); this contract's new_control_semantics override them.

new_control_semantics.frozen_convention_used: Every group cell uses the frozen convention of parameters.convention (per-link electric term 8 C_2 with the stated Casimir normalization, magnetic term -(tau/3) sum_f W_f with W_f = Re chi_fund(U_f)/dim fund, face energy 32 C_F, first-order creation c^(1) = -(tau/3)/(32 C_F) sum_f W_f Omega_0); a cell computed under another normalization, or a value copied from the SU(2) record, is rejected.
new_control_semantics.su2_constants_not_transferred: The SU(2) values 1/144 and tau=96/g^4 (and alpha=g^2/(2a)) are never used for another group; each group's first-order coefficient is derived in its own cell, and no dictionary to a bare coupling is asserted for any group other than SU(2).
new_control_semantics.flip_criterion_central_minus_one: The flip lemma U_E H(tau) U_E^* = H(-tau) is claimed for a group exactly when a central z with rho_fund(z) = -I is exhibited (and U_E commutes with every Casimir and gauge action); a group without such z receives no flip claim and its obstruction cell is mandatory.
new_control_semantics.parity_criterion_third_moment: The first-order parity (vanishing first-order tau-derivatives of omega(W^2) and of the centred correlations) is claimed for a group exactly when E_Haar[W^3]=0 is proved exactly together with single-occurrence orthogonality; flip and parity are separate columns (a group may have parity without flip).
new_control_semantics.moment_tables_two_routes: Every Haar moment E[W^k], k=1..4, and every first-order coefficient is computed exactly by both routes (characters/Peter-Weyl and Weyl integration) and must agree exactly; a single-route cell or a floating-point moment is rejected.
new_control_semantics.su3_obstruction_mandatory: The SU(3) cell exhibits exactly: no central -I (det(-I)=-1), E[W^3] nonzero, and on the SU(3) one-plaquette graph a nonzero first-order tau-derivative of omega(W^2) and a nonzero second-order coefficient of omega(W) (so omega(W) is not odd in tau); omitting the cell or calling SU(3) a transfer is rejected.
new_control_semantics.so3_obstruction_mandatory: The SO(3) (vector representation, trivial centre) cell exhibits exactly: no central element acting as -1, E[W^3] nonzero, and the same two nonzero one-plaquette coefficients; omitting it is rejected.
new_control_semantics.flip_sets_verified: The flip sets E_3 (Z^3; the AW1 set) and E_2 = {(p,x): p_y even} (Z^2) are verified by exact enumeration to meet every plaquette of the named boxes in an odd number of links (E_2: exactly one), including the 24-link coarse factors for E_3; periodic tori with an odd side are recorded as an obstruction, not verified.
new_control_semantics.area_parity_scope: The SU(2) area-parity corollary omega(W_C)(-tau) = (-1)^{A(C)} omega(W_C)(tau) is claimed in every open centered whole-star box and every on-site cutoff at kappa=0 for loops C whose spanning surface has A(C) plaquettes, and for the limit of the named constructions pointwise through BB2 at each sign; it is never claimed for other boundary conditions or at kappa nonzero.
new_control_semantics.one_plaquette_model_terms: Each one-plaquette finite model is H_FG(G) = 32 C_2 (on the character chi_r) - (tau/3) W on class functions of the holonomy, with its free reference computed in the same code path, labelled model_is_finite_graph:true and transfers_to_aq:false; the coefficient it gives is a finite-model value, never a lattice-limit value.
new_control_semantics.no_transfer_called_prediction: A transferred equation is a labelled statement about a named model with its own exact checks; the words predicts and confirms are forbidden, and a non-transfer is recorded with its exact counterexample.
new_control_semantics.am2_not_reinstantiated: No AM2, AV1 or AQ chain is claimed for any group other than SU(2); the U(1) and Z2 transfer is of the flip lemma, the parity theorem and the first-order coefficient only, with the AM2 re-instantiation recorded as an obligation.

preregistration.mandatory_sentence_template: Under the frozen convention, the link-flip lemma transfers exactly to the listed gauge groups that have a central element acting as -1 on the Wilson representation and the first-order parity theorem exactly to those with vanishing third Haar moment of W, each with its own first-order Wilson coefficient; SU(3) and SO(3) are recorded obstructions with exact nonzero coefficients; for SU(2) the Wilson-loop mean is odd or even in tau by the parity of the enclosed area in every box and for the limit of the named constructions; these are statements about named models and one-plaquette finite graphs, not AM2 or continuum statements for other groups, not uniqueness of any ground state, and not a statement uniform in the lattice spacing a.
